tags: Acorn Black Old World Ring Pulls

text.description_html:
Acorn APABP, Smooth Iron Old World Cabinet Ring Pull

This decorative old world ring pull is for light interior doors, cabinet doors, cabinet drawers, anywhere that an old world ring pull would be good. It is easy to install with the four included screws. Acorn's Smooth Iron Old World Cabinet Ring Pull is typical of Early American styling, with a matte black appearance which simulates the hardware as it was originally forged. It is also typical of early European and Colonial American styles, anywhere hand made forged home hardware was used.

Finished for interior applications. For exterior applications please use Acorn APZBP Old World Ring Pull

Specifications for the Acorn APABP Old World Ring Pull:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Plate Width: 2"
  • Plate Height: 1-7/16"
  • Pull Ring Diameter: 1/4" Steel
  • Plate Material: Cast Zinc Aluminum
  • Packaged with installation screws.

Sold Individually
